card.name: Fresh, oral, land and pH terms
card.fires_on: Single descriptive words in environment or route-of-administration phrases, such as fresh before water, oral before drug names, land before animals, and pH or humid. The word marked is usually an adjective or first part of a term.

modes.label: Water and land settings
modes.description: Adjectives describing natural settings or moisture, like fresh, land, humid, pH, eastern.
modes.example: These tend to breed in bodies of permanent<< fresh>> water.

modes.label: Oral route wording
modes.description: The word oral or orally before a drug or treatment term.

card.plain: It fires on a descriptive word like fresh, oral or land that sits just before the noun it describes.
